The '''Red Light Orphanage''' was an orphanage located within the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] lived there until she discovered the institution was about to sell her. She crashed the bank account of the orphanage and escaped with the credits.<ref name="Holonet" />
